report.status_line: The trailer tank carrying our water resupply ruptured, leaving about 360 L for 7 crew, which lasts until Jan 17 at the FMARS average rate.

concerns.title: Water resupply lost
concerns.detail: The engineering report says the trailer tank ruptured and the commander estimates ~360 L remain for 7 crew. At the FMARS average of 12.12 L per person per day that runs out on 2015-01-17; at the NASA drinking minimum of 2.5 L it would last to 2015-02-02. Mission end is 10 days away.

concerns.title: Propane falling fast
concerns.detail: Propane went from 45% to 40% in one day. If that continues it is empty in about 8 days, before mission end. This is an early estimate from 2 readings.

concerns.title: Two ATVs not running
concerns.detail: ATV 3 shuts down after starting and ATV 5 does not start at all.

crew_actions: Cut water use to essentials now and record tank levels in every report.
Re-read the propane gauge tomorrow to confirm or drop the 8-day estimate.
Keep EVAs that need ATVs 3 and 5 off the schedule until they are repaired.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Schedule an emergency water delivery before Jan 17.
decisions_for_earth.why: About 360 L for 7 crew runs out on Jan 17 at the FMARS average rate, and the trailer tank that would refill the static tank ruptured.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Send the crew a water-shortage procedure.
decisions_for_earth.why: The commander reports the crew knows of no procedure for water shortages and asked Mission Support for one.

report.message_to_earth: Crew 147, Jan 13. The trailer tank carrying our water resupply ruptured. We estimate about 360 L of water left for 7 crew. At the FMARS analog average of 12.12 L per person per day that lasts until Jan 17; even at the NASA drinking minimum of 2.5 L it lasts only until Feb 2. Decisions needed: (1) schedule an emergency water delivery before Jan 17; (2) send us a water-shortage procedure, since we have none. Also: propane dropped from 45% to 40% in one day (early estimate: empty in about 8 days), and ATVs 3 and 5 are not running.
